name: Lodging 5
definition: Lodging provides summary information about lodging accommodations and related expenses for the cardholder.

FolioNumber.name: Folio Number
FolioNumber.definition: Contains the lodging company's invoice or billing ID reference number, referred to as a folio number.

PropertyType.name: Property Type
PropertyType.definition: Type of accommodations. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

PrestigiousProperty.name: Prestigious Property
PrestigiousProperty.definition: Identifier that describes the lodging establishment as a prestigious property.

PropertyLegalCorporateName.name: Property Legal Corporate Name
PropertyLegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the property.

PropertyLocalTimeZone.name: Property Local Time Zone
PropertyLocalTimeZone.definition: Local time zone of the property.

PropertyLocalData.name: Property Local Data
PropertyLocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of property data.

PropertyFireSafetyAct.name: Property Fire Safety Act
PropertyFireSafetyAct.definition: Indicates whether or not the lodging facility complies with the US Hotel and Motel Fire Safety Act of 1990 (PL101-391) or similar legislation.||True = in compliance|False = not in compliance

NumberOfRooms.name: Number Of Rooms
NumberOfRooms.definition: Number of rooms within the reservation.

NoShow.name: No Show
NoShow.definition: Indicates that the cardholder failed to arrive at the property and was therefore charged a no-show fee; property was not actually rented.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

TotalTax.name: Total Tax
TotalTax.definition: Taxes related to the products or services.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Contains the total amount of lodging expenses.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

LineItem.name: Line Item
LineItem.definition: Component provides detailed information about lodging accommodations and related expenses for the cardholder. Acquirers can submit multiple occurrences of this component for each lodging transaction, to provide details of one or more folios.
